decisions.slice: I-4-4D6: migrate the pr-review-judge CI evidence helper (ci_verdict_summary.py) and the deterministic gate runner (check_pr_review_gates.py) with their source tests, the six CI fixtures and the existing PR_REVIEW_GATE_RESULT_V1 schema. No wrapper, new schema or permanent gate is added; the existing runner scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py is reused.
decisions.schema_fix: Two necessary behaviour changes: (1) validate_against_schema fails closed (exit 2) when the schema cannot be trusted. The source fell back silently to a weaker built-in schema (reproduced: exit 0 / APPROVE with a missing, malformed or schema-less file). The schema file itself, its path and its keys are unchanged. (2) main() validates before it publishes: on a schema failure nothing is printed to stdout and --output is not written (exit 2); valid APPROVE (exit 0) and REQUEST_CHANGES (exit 1) output is unchanged.
decisions.no_mutation: Both scripts only read GitHub (gh pr view / gh api graphql query / gh run view --log) and write local artifacts. The closure test runs them against a fake gh that records every call and asserts there is no write form.
decisions.skill_state: pr-review-judge/SKILL.md and impl-review-loop/SKILL.md keep the temporary disable-model-invocation: true. This slice does not preload a Skill, dispatch pr-reviewer / pr-reviewer-lite or publish a verdict; passing source tests is not proof of production operation.
decisions.monolithic_suite: The source test_check_pr_review_gates.py imports the unmigrated generate_ci_test_selection_artifact.py and is NOT included. It is owned by the generator slice (see unmigrated_references). The migrated test_check_pr_review_gates_indeterminate.py plus the D6 closure real-CLI and real-schema cases cover the gate runner here; no source assertion is weakened.
decisions.stdout_vs_exit_code: Resolved in the D6 final-review fix (PR #100): main() now runs validate_against_schema before any stdout print or --output write. On a missing / malformed / invalid schema it exits 2 with empty stdout and no new --output file (JSON and YAML verified with the real CLI); valid APPROVE exits 0 and REQUEST_CHANGES exits 1 with the same output as before. The exit code is still the primary signal.

authority.ci_verdict_summary_role: auxiliary CI provenance summary (CI_VERDICT_SUMMARY_V1); it never replaces wait_ci_checks.py and neither script imports it
authority.gate_runner_role: deterministic gate booleans / schema consumer (PR_REVIEW_GATE_RESULT_V1); it generates no semantic findings and its APPROVE is not a semantic code review nor a required-CI success claim

legacy_ci_contract.note: ci_verdict_summary.py carries HEAD_SHA_NULL_SKIPPED_EXCLUDE_RULES, a legacy allow-list of workflow / check names of the source repository (deploy-pages, agent-retro-index, Check Japanese Content, retro-live-verification). It is kept verbatim because it only excludes conditional `skipped` checks that have no head SHA. None of those workflows exist in this repository's .github/workflows/ci.yml, so the rule is inert here.
legacy_ci_contract.rule: A legacy workflow name is never evidence that this repository's required CI passed. Required-CI success is decided only by wait_ci_checks.py on the final PR HEAD (see authority).
